---
title: "Reduction of Order Flowchart"
format: html
---

<style>
.flow-container {
  position: relative;
  height: 650px;
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  font-family: sans-serif;
}

/* Common node styling */
.node {
  padding: 15px 25px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  min-width: 200px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  transition: transform 0.2s;
  position: relative;
}

.node:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
}

/* Color scheme similar to Wronskian */
.step1, .step2, .step3, .step4 {
  background: #e3f2fd;          /* light blue background */
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;    /* blue border */
}

.side-left, .side-right {
  background: #fff8e1;          /* light yellow background */
  border: 2px solid #ff9800;    /* orange border */
}

/* Grid placement */
.step1 { grid-column: 2 / 3; grid-row: 1 / 2; }
.step2 { grid-column: 2 / 3; grid-row: 2 / 3; }
.step3 { grid-column: 2 / 3; grid-row: 3 / 4; }
.step4 { grid-column: 2 / 3; grid-row: 4 / 5; }

.side-left { grid-column: 1 / 2; grid-row: 4 / 5; }
.side-right { grid-column: 3 / 4; grid-row: 4 / 5; }
</style>

<div class="flow-container">
  <div id="step1" class="node step1">Given one solution:<br>\( y_1 \)</div>
  <div id="step2" class="node step2">Assume:<br>\( y = y_1 \cdot u \)</div>
  <div id="step3" class="node step3">Find \( y' \), set \( w = u' \), then find \( w \)</div>
  <div id="step4" class="node step4">Solve for \( u \), then plug into:<br>\( y = y_1 \cdot u \)</div>

  <div id="left" class="node side-left">Alternative:<br>Use substitution method</div>
  <div id="right" class="node side-right">
  Or use direct formula<br>
</div>


<script src="https://anseki.github.io/leader-line/leader-line.min.js"></script>
<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const lineOptions = {
      startPlug: 'disc',
      endPlug: 'arrow1',
      size: 2,
      path: 'straight',
      color: '#1976d2'  // main blue color for vertical flow
    };

    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step1'), document.getElementById('step2'), lineOptions);
    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step2'), document.getElementById('step3'), lineOptions);
    new LeaderLine(document.getElementById('step3'), document.getElementById('step4'), lineOptions);

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('step4'),
      document.getElementById('left'),
      { ...lineOptions, path: 'arc', color: '#e91e63' } // pink for left branch
    );

    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('step4'),
      document.getElementById('right'),
      { ...lineOptions, path: 'arc', color: '#4caf50' } // green for right branch
    );
  });
</script>
